purpose: M09-AUDIT-26 caller/resource inventory: every caller of the M09 shared Hub state/query/action seams, how it reaches AppKit, and the test that covers it. Locations are path::symbol (stable across edits); the tree is the one named in code_sha.
method: The expressions were adapted to the current symbol names (e.g. set_excluded does not exist; the service method is exclude). Zero hits for a guessed alias were not taken as proof of no callers: each production hit was read in context.

threads.main: AppKit main thread (NSApp run loop); every widget mutation
threads.localflow-hub-query-worker: HubState.QueryExecutor pool (<= 4 threads, <= 2 running per key); runs loaders, publishes through _publish_locked
threads.localflow-hub-work: HubController._in_background worker, one per long action
threads.store-writer: Store single writer thread (Store.submit ops, deletion listeners)
threads.localflow-v2-insertion: InsertionService queue thread (one operation at a time; idle listeners)

appkit_mutation_paths.route: loader on localflow-hub-query-worker -> HubState._publish_locked (guarded, lock) -> HubState._publish -> on_update = HubController._state_updated -> AppHelper.callAfter(_refresh, view) -> main

Store deletion listener (store-writer) -> HubController._store_job_deleted: HubState.revoke_job + ReplayService.revoke_job (flags only) -> on_revoked = _state_revoked -> AppHelper.callAfter(_revoke_rendered) -> main; replay stop via AppHelper.callAfter(replay.stop_revoked); _revoke_rendered also clears a hidden Training detail, a rendered Review queue listing the job and an invalidated Your Voice rendering
AppDelegate._retention_pass (after Store.prune) -> HubState.revalidate() -> reloads under the fence -> query publication path
HubController._in_background(work, done, key) -> thread localflow-hub-work -> AppHelper.callAfter(_finish_action, done, key, token, ...) -> main; done(out, err, current) reports only when current
button on main -> ReplayService.play_artifact (reads artifact, builds NSSound, plays; synchronous on main) -> status dict; revocation stops on main
appkit_mutation_paths.note: decode+start measured 10 ms for a 600 s recording (M09-C063, NARROWED: audibility is manual M09-V003)

appkit_mutation_paths.route: AppDelegate.openHub_ -> _hub_blocks_show (registers _insertion_idle, then reads InsertionService.pending) -> defer; InsertionService idle listener (localflow-v2-insertion) -> _insertion_idle -> AppHelper.callAfter(_flush_pending_hub_show) -> main
button on main -> service op via Store.submit (blocks main for the writer's hold, <= 15 s timeout)
appkit_mutation_paths.note: documented limitation (M09-AUDIT-27): a 1000 ms writer hold blocked main 1004-1005 ms; History searches admitted meanwhile stayed off main (M09-C018, M09-C113, NARROWED)
